projects.title: SuperSort
projects.goal: Search for genuinely new, architecture-aware mechanisms that make practically relevant sorting tasks substantially faster than the best existing implementations.

latest.title: Page reuse in completed taxi-trip batches
latest.summary: Only one of twelve weekly pairs overlapped in pickup time. Four rows of that pair fell inside the overlap, and choosing the output offset did not increase its page reuse.
latest.result: 1/12 weekly pairs overlapped and 0/12 put at least 5% of rows in the overlap
